environment.description: Same Node.js 18 Apollo server deployed on Ubuntu 22.04 host with a custom AppArmor profile loaded via aa-enforce. The profile (named 'graphql-archive-svc') specifies: owner /app/extracted/** rw, owner /app/uploads/** rw, /app/node_modules/** r, /usr/local/bin/node ix, deny /etc/** w, deny /tmp/** w, deny /** w. The profile uses 'file' rule inheritance with no 'complain' fallback and includes an explicit 'deny' for path_regex matching anything resolved outside /app/extracted/ and /app/uploads/. The profile was generated via bane with additional hand-tuned deny rules and is enforced at PID 1 level via the container runtime's --security-opt apparmor=graphql-archive-svc flag. Note: the profile allows read access broadly for node module resolution but write operations are confined strictly to the two application directories.

config.runtime: Docker node:18-slim on dedicated EC2 host
